Artificial Analysis Progress Index v1, Over Time
Each lab’s line shows its highest-scoring model available at that point in time, using each model’s highest-scoring effort variant. Read the Progress Index v1 methodology.

For example, an older model might have been tested on easier benchmarks and a newer model on harder ones. Models tested on both sets help us estimate the difference in difficulty and compare the older and newer models on the same scale.
